blind.description: An ornate, neoclassical salon side chair with an upholstered square seat and rectangular backrest. The frame and fluted legs are cream/ivory painted wood with gilded carvings, corner blocks, and top crest ornament. The upholstery is dark emerald green fabric patterned with gold fleur-de-lis or small floral motifs on both the seat cushion and backrest panel.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a square green cushion with golden floral motifs, bordered by an ivory and gilt back rail at the top with two square finials and a central gold crest.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.2 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.6 feet wide.
